# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 17 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Private Home Sales & Land Bids

- **October 2026 developer sales surge to 1,716 homes** - New private home sales (excluding ECs) rebounded sharply in October 2026, rising 479.7% from the 296 units sold in September, marking the highest monthly volume since October 2025, with Thomson Reserve and Lucerne Grand leading take-up. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/october-2026-developer-sales/)

- **Orchard Boulevard GLS site awarded at S$1,755 psf ppr** - URA awarded the Orchard Boulevard Government Land Sale site to a Hong Leong–TID joint venture (Intrepid Investments and TID Residential) for S$181.86 million, or approximately S$1,755 psf per plot ratio. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hong-leong-tid-jv-top-bids-orchard-boulevard-gls-site-at-s1755-psf-ppr/)

- **Rising construction costs may shift developers toward asset enhancement** - JLL expects Singapore construction costs to rise 2.5%–3.5% in 2026, a trend that may push developers toward asset enhancement and adaptive reuse rather than new builds. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/rising-construction-costs-set-force-developers/)

## HDB Market — Resale & BTO

- **Yishun records first S$1.3M HDB resale** - A 1,765 sq ft executive apartment at Yishun Avenue 4 sold for S$1,328,888 in November 2026, becoming Yishun's most expensive HDB resale across all flat types and the first in the town to cross S$1.3 million. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/yishun-hdb-resale-record-nee-soon-central-view/)

- **November 2026 BTO exercise draws roughly four applications per flat** - HDB's November 2026 BTO exercise received 31,776 applications for 7,964 flats, with Tengah leading overall demand and Toa Payoh's 4-room flats attracting strong interest. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/november-2026-bto-application-rates/)

- **February 2027 BTO exercise to offer about 4,300 flats across four towns** - HDB's upcoming February 2027 BTO launch will cover Bishan, Toa Payoh, Tampines and Tengah, with a site-by-site review of expected prices and demand published ahead of the exercise. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/review-february-2027-bto-launch-sites/)
